newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ANSYS cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ANSYS cut to neutral.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown said analyst Philip Rueppel lowered his recommendation on ANSYS Inc to neutral from buy.
-- Rueppel was not immediately available to comment on the move.
-- ANSYS stock was off 4-3/4, or almost 37 percent, to 8-1/8 in late morning Nasdaq trade.
-- Early Wednesday, the company said it expects revenue for the fourth quarter ended December 31 to total about $12.3 million, or about 90 percent of published estimates by analysts.
